capability_limits.site_crawl: Manual bounded page reads; no installed crawler; live reachability unverified
capability_limits.serp_research: Observed search results only; no geo/device rank tracker
capability_limits.keyword_research: Semrush via the user's logged-in Chrome when the user connects it (volume, KD, intent); otherwise qualitative topics only and volume/KD are unknown. Selection rule: see keyword_strategy
capability_limits.cms_read: Local source/schema only; authenticated CMS content access unverified
capability_limits.search_console_read: Manual authenticated browser reports only; domain property mulangapparel.com verified (2026-11-02; change of address from lin6666.top submitted). No Search Console API/OAuth integration; recheck session access each run.

keyword_strategy.target: medium search volume with low keyword difficulty; prefer B2B manufacturer/commercial intent
keyword_strategy.source: Semrush (user connects; queried in the user's Chrome) plus keywords the user supplies
keyword_strategy.rule: Shortlist only with real Semrush numbers recorded with date and database (US first); never invent volume or KD; one primary keyword per URL, map to an existing page before creating a new one
